description:
🚀 ¿Por qué trabajar en Xepelin?
Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network, se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?
🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?
En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

El objetivo de esta posición es potenciar la adquisición de clientes de Xepelin a través del análisis de datos, convirtiendo información clave en decisiones estratégicas de crecimiento.

Principales Responsabilidades:

Apoyar en el diseño de estrategias de adquisición de clientes, a través de análisis de datos profundo de campañas, funnels y canales para identificar oportunidades de aumentar la conversión. 
Trabajar muy de la mano con los equipos de Revenue, Growth Engineering y Data en la optimización de procesos de adquisición, impulsando la adopción de nuevas herramientas y tecnologías para mejorar la eficiencia y escalabilidad. 
Recolectar y analizar información clave del negocio para transformarla en insights claros y accionables que respalden decisiones estratégicas de crecimiento. 
Diseñar y actualizar dashboards y reportes ejecutivos con KPIs clave (ej. tasa de conversión, costo de adquisición, tiempo de cierre), asegurando que los stakeholders tengan visibilidad en tiempo real del desempeño y áreas de mejora. 
Participar en la revisión y ajuste del modelo operativo y propuesta de valor, analizando métricas comerciales y feedback de clientes para recomendar cambios que aumenten la adquisición y el impacto en resultados. 



¿Qué necesitas para brillar?

Ser estudiante universitario/a activo en carreras como Negocios, Economía, Ingeniería, o similares.. Ideal si tienes algo de experiencia en Consultoría, Fintech o ambientes de trabajo dinámicos. 
Habilidades analíticas y capacidad para trabajar con datos y generar insights accionables. 
Manejo avanzado de Excel e intermedio-avanzado de SQL. 
Capacidad para estructurar y resolver problemas ambiguos y complejos. 
Alta atención al detalle y estándares de calidad. 
Proactividad, autonomía y ganas de aprender. 
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo. 
Comodidad para cuestionar el status quo de los servicios financieros y adaptarse rápidamente a cambios. 



Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

description:

The Opportunity: Head of Growth, Tilt Mexico

Mexico was Tilt's first market outside the US. Since 2022, our mobile-first personal loan has helped over 1 million customers access short-term credit on transparent, affordable terms. We now offer a 3-month installment loan and are rolling out a credit card in beta. As Head of Growth, you'll own how Tilt Mexico finds, activates and keeps customers across all three products, with real budget accountability and the mandate to drive profitable growth.

Acquisition works today but is concentrated in a few paid channels. Lifecycle and cross-sell are early, and the brand is under-measured. This is a chance to build an AI-native growth function in one of Latin America's largest and fastest-moving consumer credit markets.

This is a remote role based in Mexico. Travel for company onsites is expected at least four times a year.

Partner with Product and Engineering to define what the lifecycle stack needs, and own the strategy that runs on it.
Run a small, leveraged team: Lead a tight, high-output team that uses AI for creative production, budget allocation and analytics rather than defaulting to headcount growth. Share what works with the growth teams in our other markets: the US, Brazil, India and the Philippines.


Why you're a great fit


8+ years in growth or marketing, with hands-on performance marketing experience earlier in your career. You've personally run campaigns, not just overseen them.
You've had real budget accountability: your name on spend decisions, not just advisory input.
Consumer fintech or digital lending experience in Mexico or Latin America. You understand how acquisition cost, approval rates and credit losses shape what growth is worth.

Súmate a Vemo y activa el cambio con nosotros.




¿Quiénes somos?

En Vemo somos un ecosistema integral de electromovilidad. Conectamos tecnología, infraestructura y personas para hacer posible una mejor forma de movernos.

Nos mueve hacer que más personas y empresas puedan dar el paso hacia la movilidad eléctrica. Todos los días integramos soluciones y acompañamiento para resolver los retos de esa transición, con las personas al centro de lo que construimos. Y queremos que seas parte.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un Growth Analyst de Paid Media que convierta cada peso invertido en Meta y Google en resultados de negocio medibles, con foco en datos, medición y automatización. Debe tener mentalidad de negocio y ligar el rendimiento de medios con las etapas cruciales del funnel y las unidades de negocio, no con métricas de plataforma. Optimizar la inversión con datos, construir la medición que alimenta a los algoritmos y aplicar IA para que la operación de pauta escale.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Ser dueño/a del rendimiento de la inversión en medios pagados: decides dónde va el siguiente peso con base en el costo por etapa crucial del funnel y el retorno por línea de negocio, y construyes el sistema de medición que le da a Meta y Google señales de clientes reales, no de leads.




Tus principales responsabilidades serán:




Performance y Optimización de Medios

Gestionarás y optimizarás campañas en Meta Ads y Google Ads (Search y Performance Max) para las líneas de negocio de Vemo, con estructura, pujas y audiencias basadas en datos.

Diseñarás y leerás experimentos de medios con rigor estadístico: tests de creativos y audiencias, estructuras de campaña, holdouts geográficos e incrementalidad.
Traducirás los datos de rendimiento creativo en briefs accionables para diseño y copy: qué hook, formato y ángulo escalar y cuál apagar.
Pronosticarás inversión y resultados (escenarios de presupuesto y rendimientos decrecientes por canal) para la planeación mensual.




Medición y Atribución

Implementarás y mantendrás el tracking de medios: Pixel y Conversions API, etiquetas de Google Ads, GTM, GA4 y taxonomía de UTMs.
Implementarás offline conversions: enviarás etapas de Microsoft Dynamics 365 a Meta y Google Ads para que los algoritmos optimicen hacia clientes reales.
Construirás la atribución de medios uniendo plataformas de ads, GA4 y Dynamics 365, y reconciliarás las discrepancias entre fuentes.
Calcularás y reportarás CAC, costo por etapa y payback por línea de negocio y canal.




Automatización y Data

Automatizarás, junto con BI, la extracción y consolidación de datos de las plataformas de ads (APIs y conectores) sin archivos manuales.
Automatizarás los reportes recurrentes de medios: pacing diario, reporte semanal y revisión mensual de negocio.
Operarás un sistema de alertas sobre la inversión: sobre o sub pacing, picos de costo por etapa, caídas de tracking, anuncios rechazados y UTMs rotas.
Serás dueño/a del naming convention y del catálogo de métricas de medios: definición, fuente y lógica de cálculo de cada KPI.




IA aplicada a Paid Media

Montarás agentes y flujos con LLMs para análisis recurrentes de las cuentas: resúmenes de performance, explicación de variaciones y detección de anomalías.
Usarás IA para clasificar creativos y copies por ángulo, hook y formato, y leer qué patrones convierten.
Reducirás la operación manual de las cuentas con scripts de Google Ads, reglas automatizadas y la API de Meta.




Requisitos básicos:

 1 a 3 años experiencia en performance marketing o paid media, manejando directamente campañas de Meta Ads y Google Ads (Search y Performance Max) con presupuesto propio. Idealmente en empresas de alto crecimiento con ciclos de venta largos (fintech, movilidad, autos, seguros, leasing o inmobiliario).
Conocimiento práctico de Pixel, Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4 y taxonomía de UTMs, y experiencia trabajando con ellos en campañas reales. 
Excel o Google Sheets avanzado y experiencia construyendo dashboards en Looker Studio, Power BI o similar.
Experiencia diseñando y leyendo tests de creativos, audiencias o estructuras de campaña.

Experiencia con CRM conectado a pauta (Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce o HubSpot).
Diseño de experimentos de incrementalidad o holdouts geográficos.
Scripts de Google Ads, reglas automatizadas o uso de la API de Meta.

Análisis de datos con mentalidad de negocio, ligando la inversión con CAC, costo por etapa del funnel y retorno por línea de negocio.

El cambio lo activamos en equipo, y tu talento puede llevarnos más lejos. En Vemo, cada persona aporta experiencias, ideas y perspectivas que nos ayudan a resolver retos y construir mejores soluciones. Aquí queremos que puedas ser tú, compartir lo que sabes y descubrir nuevas formas de crecer.

description:
Hello! 







At Factorial we're looking for a new Performance Marketing Manager for the Mexican market to help us support and scale our Paid Channels team to the next level. As part of the team in charge of driving customer acquisition and accelerating our growth, you'll be in charge of owning our paid acquisition strategy, experimenting with new growth opportunities, and working closely with Marketing and Sales to turn campaigns into qualified pipeline, new customers and recurring revenue.







Ready to be part of the challenge? 







About the Team 







Our Marketing team brings Factorial’s story to life, connecting our solutions with the businesses that need them most. We combine creativity, data, and experimentation to build impactful campaigns and drive sustainable growth across markets.







About the Role 







You’ll lead the strategy and execution of our paid acquisition channels in Mexico, reporting to our Global Expansion team and Paid Growth leadership. Your mission is to scale customer acquisition, improve marketing efficiency, and strengthen Factorial’s position in the Mexican market.







We’re looking for someone who goes beyond clicks and leads — someone who understands how performance marketing contributes to pipeline quality, customer acquisition, and long-term revenue growth.







What You’ll Do 

Own and optimize paid acquisition channels, including Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant platforms for the Mexican market.
Develop and execute performance strategies focused on qualified pipeline, cost per deal, and MRR growth.
Partner closely with the LATAM Sales Development team to improve lead quality and optimize full-funnel conversion.
Build a test-and-learn roadmap across bidding strategies, targeting, messaging, and ad formats tailored to the Mexican audience.
Collaborate with CRO and Content teams to improve landing pages, ad creatives, and conversion rates.
Analyze campaign performance and connect marketing investment to closed-won deals and recurring revenue.
Identify and test new acquisition channels and growth opportunities within the Mexican B2B landscape.
Own performance marketing reporting and collaborate with relevant teams to ensure accurate attribution and data-driven decision-making.







What Are We Looking For? 

3-5 years of experience in performance marketing, ideally in SaaS, B2B, or lead-generation environments.
Strong hands-on expertise in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and GA4.
Proven experience scaling paid acquisition campaigns while improving efficiency and business outcomes.
A data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate campaign performance into actionable growth strategies.
Experience with ad copywriting and a strong understanding of creative performance and audience testing.
A commercial mindset and the ability to connect marketing metrics with pipeline, customer acquisition, and revenue.
A proactive, self-driven team player who thrives in cross-functional and international environments.
Professional fluency in English and native Spanish.













Perks of being part of Factorial 







High growth, multicultural and friendly environment 
Private health insurance 
Healthy life with Wellhub (Gyms, pools, outdoor classes) 
Flexible retribution with Cobee
Language classes 
Breakfast and snacks in the office 
Much more that we'll spill during the interview process










About Factorial 







Founded in Barcelona in 2016, we now have +1,700 employees serving more than 16,000 companies across 112 countries.







Factorial started with a simple idea: companies were spending too much time managing processes and not enough time doing the work they were hired to do: their best work.







But as companies grow, work gets more disconnected. More people, more tools, more information, and more time spent connecting the dots. Generic AI can answer questions, but it doesn’t know your company. Every time, you have to give it the context.







Factorial is different. Because it’s inside the company, it already knows how it works, including its people, processes, policies, and data. So you can ask it to do real work, from screening candidates and managing expenses to answering questions and creating reports.







AI isn’t the goal. Giving people back their time is.







Factorial is the AI for Business that knows companies, connects how work happens across the business, and turns that context into action.







When work changes, so do we.







We believe in diverse talent: we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strongly encourage people of diverse experiences and identities to apply.







We believe in inclusion: we are committed to equal opportunities and actively promote workplace inclusion of people with disabilities. If you would like to learn more about our inclusive recruitment processes, you are welcome to indicate so optionally and we will share additional information with you.







Our values 







We own it: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.
We learn and teach: We're dedicated to learning something new every day and, above all, share it.
We partner: Every decision is a team decision. We trust each other.
We grow fast: We act fast. We think that the worst mistake is not learning from them.

description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

About the job

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

Design and implement initiatives to acquire new drivers, being able to leverage data for the decision making process.
Manage the launch and execution of incentives, projects, communications and product developments needed for driver acquisition, ensuring efficiency and expansion.
Be primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, managing expectations and prioritizing operations to deliver results, whilst constantly working along cross-functional teams (Marketing, Legal, City Operations, Product, etc).
Define and manage data dashboards to monitor national performance of driver acquisition and our results.
Ownership of driver acquisition incentives, across multiple countries in Spanish Speaking LatAm.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The successful applicant:


Bachelor's Degree: Engineering, Data Science, Actuary or any related field.

Resilient: proven to be self-motivated, self-directed, and eager to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.

Problem Solver with unique strength towards identifying bottlenecks and coming up with creative solutions.
Data-driven core: passion for data analytics and programming, with knowledge/experience in SQL (Nice to have: Python, R, etc.). Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets) are a must. Comfortable about learning and using new software tools.
Effective communication skills. Proficiency in English & Spanish. We're an international team!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES:

ESTRATEGIA DE CONTENIDOS Y COPYWRITING


Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de contenidos para canales digitales orgánicos y campañas de pauta.
Desarrollar conceptos creativos, mensajes clave, storytelling, copies, claims y CTA para campañas de Marketing y Fundraising.
Adaptar mensajes según audiencia, canal, etapa del journey y objetivo de comunicación o conversión.
Desarrollar y mantener calendario editorial de contenido.


Asegurar consistencia con la identidad, tono de voz, posicionamiento y lineamientos de World Vision.

CONTENIDO DIGITAL, WEB, BLOG Y CRM


Redactar y editar contenidos para sitios web, landing pages, blogs y activos digitales.
Crear materiales para email marketing, journeys y automatizaciones de CRM/HubSpot.
Aplicar criterios básicos de SEO, UX Writing y conversión en contenidos digitales.
Colaborar en pruebas A/B de mensajes, asuntos, CTA, landing pages y otros activos.


Optimizar contenidos existentes con base en resultados y necesidades de campaña.

COORDINACIÓN CREATIVA Y EQUIPO DE DISEÑO


Coordinar la operación y priorización de solicitudes asignadas al equipo de diseño.
Traducir necesidades de Marketing y otras áreas en briefs creativos accionables.
Dar seguimiento a cargas de trabajo, tiempos, prioridades y entregables del equipo.
Revisar materiales desde una perspectiva de contenido, concepto, storytelling y consistencia de marca.


Dar retroalimentación y solicitar ajustes creativos para asegurar la calidad de los entregables.

COORDINACIÓN DE PRODUCCIÓN AUDIOVISUAL Y COBERTURAS


Coordinar briefs y requerimientos de producción audiovisual para campañas, eventos, testimoniales y contenidos institucionales.
Dar seguimiento al equipo de producción y realizar ajustes de enfoque, narrativa, guion o contenido cuando sea necesario.
Desarrollar guiones, escaletas, líneas de entrevista y conceptos para piezas audiovisuales.
Participar en coberturas de campo, eventos, comunidades y actividades institucionales.


Viajar dentro del país cuando las necesidades de cobertura y producción lo requieran; los gastos de viaje autorizados serán cubiertos conforme a las políticas vigentes.

CONTENIDO PARA DONANTES Y PRODUCTO

description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.





About the Role: 


As a Product Marketing Manager, you will work directly under experienced Marketing leadership and alongside senior PMMs who set the strategic direction while giving you real ownership to build, ship, and see your work impact JumpCloud.




Responsibilties:






Build High-Impact Sales Plays & Enablement: Create practical pitch decks, competitive battlecards, demo scripts, and objection-handling guides that equip our global sales team to win more deals. 








Craft Buyer-Centric Messaging & Collateral: Translate complex Identity and Access Management (IAM), directory services, and cloud security capabilities into clear, compelling marketing assets for technical buyers. 








Deliver Actionable Competitive Intelligence: Research key competitors, map out JumpCloud’s differentiators, and turn market insights into takeaways the sales and marketing teams can use right away. 








Turn Short Briefs into Finished Work Fast: Partner with Marketing leadership, senior PMMs, sales, and product teams to take well-defined project briefs and deliver polished assets on tight timelines. 








Use AI to Move at High Velocity: Leverage modern AI productivity tools and workflows to speed up research, sharpen copy, and scale your output across GTM initiatives.












What We're Looking for: 






2–4 Years of B2B Experience: Background in B2B SaaS or tech across roles such as product marketing, sales enablement, content marketing, customer marketing, field/partner marketing, demand generation, or corporate communications—or customer-facing roles like Sales Engineer, SDR, or Customer Success Manager with standout writing skills. 








Crisp, Persuasive Writing: Proven ability to take technical concepts and distill them into clear, engaging copy that resonates with business and technical buyers. 








Rapid Learning Curve: Ability to quickly master a new product, buyer persona, and competitive landscape, even without a traditional PMM background. 








Strong Listening & Execution: You listen closely, ask smart questions up front, and turn a concise brief into the right deliverable the first time. 








High Bias for Action & Coachability: You turn work around quickly, welcome direct feedback without ego, iterate fast, and proactively look for the next task. 








Reliability & Creative Problem-Solving: You hit your deadlines, flag blockers early when they arise, and show up with proposed solutions rather than just questions. 








Bilingual Communication: Full professional fluency in English (for global GTM collaboration and asset creation) and Spanish.



















Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role.  




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

description:
Who We Are

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Marketing  & Communications , you’re not just leading the development and execution of strategic marketing initiatives for the hotel – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

The Director of Marketing & Communications is responsible for developing and leading the integrated marketing, communications, public relations, digital, social media and brand strategy for Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal.

As a senior leader and steward of one of the world’s most distinctive luxury resorts, the Director will strengthen the resort’s positioning and desirability within the global luxury travel market while developing strategic initiatives that contribute to revenue, market share, reputation and long-term brand equity.

Working closely with Resort leadership, Sales, Revenue Management, Food & Beverage, Spa & Wellness, Events and Operations, the Director will ensure that all marketing and communications initiatives are strategically aligned, commercially relevant and consistent with Waldorf Astoria brand standards.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:


Develop and execute marketing strategies: Lead branding, messaging, and multi-channel marketing plans aligned with hotel goals, adjusting tactics based on market trends and performance data
Manage planning and operations: Oversee annual marketing budgets and coordinate resources for effective campaign deployment across traditional, digital, and social media platforms
Support B2B and catering sales: Partner with internal department leaders to develop marketing strategies that drive business transient, group, and event revenue across key segments and distribution channels
Lead content strategy: Drive the development of compelling content and marketing assets, including digital, print, and social media
Oversee agency relationships: Manage external partners such as PR, creative, and digital agencies to ensure alignment with strategic marketing goals
Report on marketing performance: Deliver strategic updates and data-driven insights for leadership, ownership, and corporate meetings
Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs


Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Manager for Latin America (LATAM), you’ll help GitLab customers in the region realize the full value of our development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform by driving adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term advocacy. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers, guiding them on Git, branching strategies, the software development lifecycle, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps best practices.

This role requires more technical depth than a typical Customer Success Manager role, but not the same level of technical expertise as a Customer Success Engineer. You’ll need to learn and use GitLab hands-on, triage technical questions, and guide customers on product and infrastructure best practices, while keeping adoption and business outcomes at the center of your work.

In this role, you’ll connect customer goals with GitLab capabilities, lead workshops and Centers of Excellence efforts, and translate product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations for both customers and GitLab account teams. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services, with success in your first year measured by customer satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the strategic relationships you build.

Business-level fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Prior experience selling services.

The Customer Success Management team at GitLab works with customers across regions to drive adoption of the GitLab DevSecOps platform, measure and communicate outcomes, and build long-term advocacy. In this role, you’ll support customers in LATAM as part of a globally distributed, all-remote team. We collaborate asynchronously with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other groups to connect customer needs with GitLab’s product and services. Work From Anywhere in LATAM & SA

Work Schedule: EST │ 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday–Friday

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for: Watch here

About The Client

A bootstrapped B2B SaaS company serving the seasonal pool and field service industry is looking for a Customer Success & Inside Sales Representative to own the entire front-line customer experience — from inbound support to warm-lead sales conversion.

The company operates two connected businesses: a software platform used by pool service operators to manage scheduling, invoicing, and technician workflows, and a physical pool service company that doubles as a training ground for new hires. Leadership is lean and founder-led, with a culture that prioritizes ownership, autonomy, and quality of work over rigid structure or high-touch oversight.

About The Role

In this role, you'll spend your first 1–2 months embedded in the physical pool service side of the business, learning firsthand the workflows and pain points that customers bring to the software platform. From there, you'll transition into full ownership of inbound customer support, technical ticket triage, and warm-lead sales conversations — toggling between order resolution and consultative selling depending on the day.

Given the seasonal nature of the business, call volume and sales activity shift significantly throughout the year. Success means customers consistently feel heard and confident after every interaction, warm leads are followed up on without prompting, and the founder is fully removed from day-to-day front-line calls.

Core Responsibilities

Inbound Customer Success & Technical Support


Answer inbound calls and emails from existing customers during core business hours (8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST)
Resolve tier-1 support inquiries using the internal knowledge base and AI-assisted search tools
Triage product bugs by collecting screenshots and replication steps, then log structured reports for engineering
Manage all customer communication in HubSpot, updating ticket status and clearing the inbox by end of shift


Warm Lead Sales & Outbound Follow-Up


Conduct 15–30 minute discovery and quoting calls with warm inbound leads from forms, demos, and trade shows
Execute HubSpot sequencing tasks to follow up on sent quotes and nurture leads through the pipeline
Own trade show lead follow-up (100–200 leads collected annually), converting leads during peak sales season
Track and report on call volume, lead-to-quote conversion, and quote-to-close rate


Dual-Business Support & Cross-Training


Complete a 1–2 month onboarding rotation within the physical pool service business to learn core workflows
Apply hands-on service experience to inform and strengthen SaaS sales conversations
Provide ongoing support to the pool service business as needed during its own peak season


CRM & Pipeline Management


Maintain HubSpot as the single source of truth, logging every call, quote, and follow-up with accurate deal stages
Run recurring operational reports to flag stalled deals and track signed quotes
Keep the task queue current, working through follow-up reminders proactively


Proactive Process Improvement


Identify patterns in repeat customer questions and recommend knowledge base updates
Use AI tools and internal documentation to self-resolve issues before escalating
Adjust daily workload and pacing to match seasonal shifts in call and sales volume


Requirements

Must-Have


2+ years of consultative B2B or B2C phone sales experience with a track record of closing deals through discovery-based conversations (not high-volume outbound/call-center dialing)
Hands-on experience managing a CRM pipeline in HubSpot (or comparable platform such as Salesforce or Zoho), including sequencing, task management, and deal-stage tracking
Experience in customer support or customer success handling live phone and email inquiries, including ticket logging and issue triage
Background in SaaS, field service, or home services industries (e.g., HVAC, plumbing, pool service, landscaping, property management)
Demonstrated quota attainment, conversion metrics, or measurable sales results in a previous role
C1+ English (CEFR) with clear, neutral pronunciation suited for direct phone-based communication with US customers
Experience working independently in a remote or distributed role with self-managed daily task queues


Nice-to-Have


Experience working in a founder-led or early-stage SaaS company (10–150 employees)

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 4 Account Managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement

Analyze account performance and client feedback to identify optimization opportunities and strategic recommendations
Track and report on key team KPIs, including client satisfaction, campaign delivery, retention, and operational efficiency
Contribute to quarterly business planning, forecasting, and revenue growth initiatives alongside Sales leadership
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, client outcomes, and team productivity




Who You Are:


5+ years in account management or client services in digital advertising, ad tech, or media, including experience managing or mentoring a team
Strong leadership and coaching skills with a passion for developing high-performing teams
Excellent communicator who builds trusted relationships with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners

Comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and driving change
 Fluent in Spanish and English (required)




Nice to Have:


 Experience with Salesforce, DV360, SSPs/DSPs, or publisher monetization platforms

description:
Why are we proud of what we do at allnex? We create coatings, products which help protect the world for all nex>t generations – and that’s exactly what you can do joining us!

Imagine how fast your smartphone would become scratched-up, ugly and unusable without a coating. Or an e-bike, the cabin of a train, a beautiful wooden floor, and countless other things in life.

Making objects and their surfaces more attractive and longer-lasting means making them more sustainable, and that’s a huge part of what working at allnex is about. No matter which role you step into, you’ll become part of a global team of passionate people who care deeply about the chemistry, quality, and global impact of coatings.

You’ll also join a highly multicultural and diverse team of more than 4,000 employees in four regions who – as part of one of the world’s leading coating resins companies – serve customers in over 100 countries across the globe.

Click here to see why we are proud of what we do in allnex!

For a sneak peek into life at allnex site, don’t miss our manufacturing Operator Movie!

Position Overview

The Junior Customer Operations Coordinator is responsible for managing customer orders and supporting the end-to-end order fulfillment process, from order entry through delivery. Acting as a key link between customers and internal functions, the role coordinates with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, warehouses, carriers, Credit, and PSRA to ensure timely shipments, accurate documentation, and effective resolution of delivery and service-related issues. By maintaining strong communication with both internal and external stakeholders, the position helps drive supply chain continuity, operational excellence, and a high level of customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities


Takes care of customers and their orders, inquiries, and complaints in a consistent, fast, friendly, and communicative manner, aligned with customer needs.
Receives customer orders (email, customer portal, EDI, phone) and enters them into the respective ERP system (SAP / customer portal).
Follows up on customer orders and independently negotiates order details with customers (delivery dates, quantities, partial deliveries).
Manages customer complaints, identifying and implementing solutions when they are related to Customer Service.
Ensures timely communication, shipment, and documentation through assertive and collaborative interaction with Sales/BU, order fulfillment teams, Credit, and PSRA.
Coordinates effectively with all areas of the Supply Chain, as well as internal and external stakeholders.
Handles consignment stock processes, including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI).


Required Skills And Experience


Experience in Customer Service is preferred candidates should have a basic understanding of Supply Chain, logistics, order fulfillment, inventory management, and transportation processes.
Strong customer focus.Good knowledge of standard office software.
Resourceful, with a strong sense of initiative and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic operational environment.
Advanced English communication skills (written and spoken) are required, as the role interacts regularly with customers and stakeholders across the United States and operates within a global business environment. 


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree required.


We offer

We are proud to offer an international working experience with a tight-knit network of employees, making it easy to connect and learn from people all across our different functions. On top of that we are a truly innovative company with a strong team spirit, openness to new ideas, and great opportunities to grow and develop your career.

description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

You work in partnership with customers to define and execute a winning growth strategy for both Mondelēz International and the customer.

How You Will Contribute

You will:


Develop and drive broad customer relationships across all levels with a key focus on building relationships at an appropriate level within the customer.
Execute the strategy for the customer
Ensure the delivery of JCBP (Joint Customer Business Plan).
Optimize the use of resources in order to obtain more profitability in the operations.



What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:


Customer-facing roles
Growing revenue and market share
Delivering results and problem solving
Understanding multiple customers, go-to market strategies, structure and business practices
Negotiating and influencing skills



More About This Role

Liderar y gestionar la estrategia regional de gestión de cuentas para el canal WHS, impulsando el crecimiento sostenible de ingresos, fortaleciendo las relaciones con clientes y asegurando la ejecución impecable de los planes comerciales. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Analyst, Marketing Operations

Why We Have This Role

Qualtrics is looking for a Senior Specialist, Marketing Operations to lead lead management operations for our Go-to-Market Marketing Operations team in Mexico City. You will own the end-to-end health of our lead management engine—how leads are created, scored, enriched, routed, and followed up—working closely with Sales Development, Sales Operations, and field marketing leads. Your work will directly accelerate speed-to-lead, MQL acceptance, and revenue attribution while shaping the next evolution of our global lead routing.

How You’ll Find Success


Outcome-driven owner: Takes visible accountability for the handoff between Marketing and Sales, ensuring high-intent leads reach the right seller fast.

How You’ll Grow

Owning a high-visibility revenue function: Sit directly at the intersection of Marketing and Sales, gaining high-impact visibility and credibility across both organizations.
Opening paths into Revenue Operations leadership: Partner daily with Sales Development, Sales Operations, and IT to build the strategic and cross-functional foundation for senior RevOps or Marketing Ops roles.


Things You’ll Do


Optimize end-to-end revenue funnel conversion: Measure, monitor, and improve the lead lifecycle from initial inquiry to MQL to closed-won opportunity.
Own and evolve global lead routing: Design, configure, and maintain LeanData routing rules, assignment logic, and territory alignment, socializing updates clearly with field marketing and sales stakeholders.
Calibrate lead and account scoring models: Partner with Demand Generation and Sales Operations to continuously tune scoring models so sales prioritizes the highest-converting leads.
Enforce follow-up SLAs and resolve routing failures: Monitor MQL acceptance rates and follow-up SLAs, diagnose routing failures across systems to fix root causes, and partner with Sales Development Ops on outreach sequences and enablement.
Maintain clean, compliant CRM and MAP data: Operate data enrichment, validation, and deduplication workflows with Sales Ops to ensure accurate Lead-to-Opportunity handoffs.
Build actionable funnel visibility and playbooks: Create Salesforce reports and dashboards tracking lead volume, routing accuracy, and conversion, while maintaining documentation as the first line of support for routing questions.


What We’re Looking For On Your Resume


3–5 years of hands-on B2B Marketing Operations or Sales Operations experience working with Marketing Automation Platforms (Marketo or Eloqua) in a fast-paced environment.
Proven experience in lead management, lead routing, and partnering closely with Sales Development teams to improve funnel conversion and SLAs.
Strong proficiency with Salesforce.com, including building funnel reports/dashboards and managing data hygiene.
Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a track record of diagnosing system/process bottlenecks and delivering under tight deadlines.
Preferred: Hands-on experience with lead routing platforms (LeanData or similar), sales engagement tools (Outreach or similar), data enrichment tools, SQL/data analysis, and Marketo Certification.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.


What You Should Know About This Team

Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and savings investment account.

Viva Talent · Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO

You'll build and improve the systems that connect Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, from first touch through expansion. You’ll use data to spot what’s slowing growth, recommend our next growth bets, and work with department heads to implement improvements and track their impact.

Connect Sales and Customer Success. Ensure post-sale information is captured in HubSpot, bring customer health and usage signals into view, and track expansion opportunities in the pipeline.
Own the RevOps improvement roadmap. Identify and prioritize systems and process improvements that remove bottlenecks, reduce manual work, and improve revenue performance.
Build and implement AI-enabled workflows. Automate repetitive GTM work and validate the accuracy and value of the outputs.
Enable growth initiatives. Turn approved recommendations into workable processes with department heads, then monitor adoption and results.
Recommend growth and investment priorities. Identify opportunities to accelerate Viva’s core growth metric and recommend where to focus resources based on expected impact, speed to results, risks, and trade-offs.




Who you are

5+ years in Revenue Operations, with hands-on ownership of systems and processes across the customer lifecycle.
C1 English and executive communication skills. You explain recommendations clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and align stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
You’ve built or significantly improved RevOps systems and processes (0-1 and 1-n), with the ability to take work from identifying the problem through implementation.
Hands-on HubSpot expertise, including lifecycle configuration, data governance, integrations, and automation.
Strong commercial judgment and independence. You identify priorities, weigh risks and trade-offs, and make recommendations that influence growth and investment decisions.
Advanced, hands-on AI and automation expertise. You’ve built and deployed workflows that significantly reduce manual work and expand what you can deliver independently, while validating accuracy and results.




Helpful experience: Working in a startup or lean team; direct sales or customer-facing experience; and familiarity with Clay, Zapier/Make/n8n, and advertising conversion integrations.




Why you'll want this

Viva’s ready for the next stage of growth, and you’ll be a key player, working alongside our Co-CEO and department heads.

You’ll have the autonomy to find our next bets, guide where we invest, and turn insights into action, helping us actually create more career opportunities for women across Latin America.




We invest heavily in our people through:

100% remote work, forever.

description:
We’re looking for a Revenue Systems Administrator to join our Revenue Operations team. This role will provide hands-on administration and support for our core revenue systems, with a focus on Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, and the workflows and integrations that connect them. The Revenue Systems Administrator will help configure, maintain, and improve our revenue technology environment based on established business requirements and technical direction. This includes day-to-day system administration, user and access management, data quality, workflow configuration, automation, integration monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and ongoing system improvements. Our philosophy is simple: fewer clicks, fewer manual updates, and fewer places for our teams to go looking for information. This role will help put that philosophy into practice by configuring and maintaining automation and AI-enabled workflows that reduce repetitive administrative work and make better use of information already available across our systems. Where appropriate, these workflows will use a human-in-the-loop approach — allowing AI and automation to prepare recommendations or updates while users retain the ability to review, confirm, modify, or reject them before changes are made to systems of record. Think: AI recommends → human verifies → systems update automatically. This role is based out of Mexico City or Mumbai, reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Analyst, Digital Media Analytics who will support the measurement and reporting of B2B advertising campaigns for a global professional services client.

In this role, you will use T-SQL, Power BI, and Excel to extract, organize, analyze, and visualize campaign data. You will collaborate with Investment, Planning, and senior Analytics teams to ensure accurate reporting, monitor campaign performance and spend pacing, and identify gaps in the data.

Key responsibilities include:


Extract, organize, and format campaign data from advertising management platforms to support analysis and reporting. 
Use T-SQL and Excel to retrieve, prepare, and analyze data, supporting accurate and consistent campaign reporting. 
Maintain, update, and perform quality assurance checks on dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI and Tableau. 
Produce campaign performance and spend pacing reports across multiple campaigns and client service lines. 
Perform recurring tracking tag QA checks to verify correct functionality and support accurate data flows. 
Help senior Analytics team members translate media metrics into clear visualizations and presentations that support decision-making. 
Review campaign objectives and performance data with the team to identify optimization opportunities and potential measurement solutions. 
Collaborate with Investment and Planning teams to gather campaign information and ensure complete reporting coverage. 
Identify and help resolve data gaps, discrepancies, and reporting issues, working with relevant teams to improve information quality. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


1–2 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or digital media analytics. 
Hands-on experience with data extraction, organization, and analysis. 
Practical experience using T-SQL to retrieve and analyze data. 
Experience using Power BI to maintain dashboards, visualize information, and support reporting. 
Proficiency in Excel for preparing, organizing, and analyzing datasets. 
Strong attention to detail and the ability to validate data, identify discrepancies, and maintain reporting accuracy. 
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly and coordinate with different stakeholders. 
A collaborative approach to working with Investment, Planning, and Analytics teams. 
Organizational skills to support multiple campaigns and recurring reporting deadlines. 
Experience with Databricks is a plus. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed from any location within Mexico or Colombia. Only candidates residing in either country who are legally authorized to work there may apply. Remote work from outside Mexico or Colombia, including relocation abroad under a remote work contract, is not permitted under any circumstances.

title: Manager,  Programmatic
skills: Onboard, maintain, and grow the assigned client portfolio; coordinate and collaborate with Account Management, Media Strategy, and programmatic leadership on a long-term strategic roadmap.

Develop programmatic strategies using knowledge, experience, and strong analytical skills to extract insights from campaign data and provide well-developed, quantitatively based recommendations to accomplish client goals and objectives.
Create presentations, regular reporting, and other documents for client use in the evaluation and approval of programmatic campaigns.

Develop programmatic campaign targeting and measurement strategies, ensuring alignment with the client’s business goals; oversee strategy implementation across all programmatic mediums (display, video, native, digital audio, CTV, and digital out of home).
Develop action plans for achieving and measuring campaign success; identify KPIs, measurement processes, and optimization strategies.
Own performance accuracy for campaign execution, optimization, and insights for all assigned clients.
Develop processes to improve team efficiency and scale processes across the broader programmatic practice.
Keep agency counterparts and clients up to date on industry trends and technology partners, seeking opportunities to vet and test new technologies.
Research, vet, and test technology partners to drive performance for clients.
Manage a team of direct reports, including remote employees and employees across all Rise locations.
Oversee all aspects of the team, including employee onboarding, training, performance (accountability and behavior), and retention.

Maintain overall control of workflow and assigned responsibilities within the team; oversee project progress and provide assistance where necessary to ensure timely completion; quickly and tactfully troubleshoot employee and client issues.
Collaborate with leadership and peers to develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency, tools, and systems, and improve current workflows.
Monitor programmatic media trends, tools, and technologies, and recommend direction for investment and implementation.
Represent Rise with vendor representatives to analyze the value and applicability of media vehicles and tactics for plan consideration, as needed.
Participate in vendor meetings with current and potential partners.
Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, advertising, or business.
Ability to speak, read, and write in English.
4+ years of relevant work experience in digital or programmatic media preferred; agency experience is a plus.
Expert use of the Microsoft Office suite, with a strong emphasis on Excel.
Experience building media plans and determining budget allocation on a yearly and monthly basis using different forecasting methodologies.
Experience developing and managing high-performance teams is a plus.
Strong relationships with publisher and technology partners.
Advanced knowledge of the importance and role of programmatic within a media plan and how to leverage its strengths.
Proven ability to convert and implement strategic plan directions into flawless tactical executions.
Demonstrated understanding of media planning concepts such as reach, frequency, frequency management, impression share, ROI, ROAS, and other KPIs.
Certificates in Google DV360, Google Campaign Manager, and The Trade Desk required.
Strong analytical capabilities and an aptitude for understanding technical nuances associated with various media buying platforms to improve client results.
Proven experience developing ongoing processes that positively impact the profitability or efficiency of an account or team.
Establishes self as a trusted resource by developing relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
Superior oral and written communication skills, with a focus on fostering strong, collaborative relationships at a tactical level.
High comfort level participating in brainstorms and ideation sessions.
Ability to work with a team to think tactically and execute accurately in order to align media execution with client needs.
description:
Rise is an award-winning, full-service Media Agency of Record that is backed by data and powered by people. We create omnichannel experiences using our proprietary tech stack and advanced analytics capabilities to help solve the unique struggles brands face today. This approach, with transparency at its core, specializes in omnichannel media, commerce and retail media, advanced in-home media, as well as content and creator marketing.

We offer "Risers" the opportunity to work in an ever-evolving industry that will foster learning and development, provide an innovative work environment with diverse projects and clients, career advancement paths a collaborative team environment, corporate social responsibility initiatives, an inclusive and diverse culture, plus association with a reputable media agency. We're looking for talent like you who can continue to elevate our work and culture.

General Purpose Of Job

The Manager, Investment, Programmatic is responsible for effectively supervising a team and set of clients, with a focus on accuracy, growth, and innovation. This individual will act as a subject matter expert on programmatic strategy and execution, assuming a client-facing role during pre-sales activity and enterprise-level client meetings. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated track record of tactical channel expertise and possess a strong understanding of channel strategy and goals.

As a supervisor, the Manager will oversee employee development and retention, including training and goal setting, and lead the team in ensuring that the tactical execution of media planning, placement, and reporting (including post-buy and financial reconciliation) are handled with accuracy and timeliness. Additionally, this individual is an expert in process and project management, efficiently creating processes that can be scaled across multiple accounts or teams.

Location: Mexico City, 3 days in office; Applicants must hold Mexican citizenship

Key Responsibilities


Onboard, maintain, and grow the assigned client portfolio; coordinate and collaborate with Account Management, Media Strategy, and programmatic leadership on a long-term strategic roadmap.
Develop programmatic strategies using knowledge, experience, and strong analytical skills to extract insights from campaign data and provide well-developed, quantitatively based recommendations to accomplish client goals and objectives.
Create presentations, regular reporting, and other documents for client use in the evaluation and approval of programmatic campaigns.
Develop programmatic campaign targeting and measurement strategies, ensuring alignment with the client’s business goals; oversee strategy implementation across all programmatic mediums (display, video, native, digital audio, CTV, and digital out of home).
Develop action plans for achieving and measuring campaign success; identify KPIs, measurement processes, and optimization strategies.
Own performance accuracy for campaign execution, optimization, and insights for all assigned clients.
Develop processes to improve team efficiency and scale processes across the broader programmatic practice.
Keep agency counterparts and clients up to date on industry trends and technology partners, seeking opportunities to vet and test new technologies.
Research, vet, and test technology partners to drive performance for clients.
Manage a team of direct reports, including remote employees and employees across all Rise locations.
Oversee all aspects of the team, including employee onboarding, training, performance (accountability and behavior), and retention.
Maintain overall control of workflow and assigned responsibilities within the team; oversee project progress and provide assistance where necessary to ensure timely completion; quickly and tactfully troubleshoot employee and client issues.
Collaborate with leadership and peers to develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency, tools, and systems, and improve current workflows.
Monitor programmatic media trends, tools, and technologies, and recommend direction for investment and implementation.
Represent Rise with vendor representatives to analyze the value and applicability of media vehicles and tactics for plan consideration, as needed.
Participate in vendor meetings with current and potential partners.


Education


Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, advertising, or business.
Ability to speak, read, and write in English.


Experience


4+ years of relevant work experience in digital or programmatic media preferred; agency experience is a plus.
Expert use of the Microsoft Office suite, with a strong emphasis on Excel.
Experience building media plans and determining budget allocation on a yearly and monthly basis using different forecasting methodologies.
Experience developing and managing high-performance teams is a plus.
Strong relationships with publisher and technology partners.
Advanced knowledge of the importance and role of programmatic within a media plan and how to leverage its strengths.
Proven ability to convert and implement strategic plan directions into flawless tactical executions.
Demonstrated understanding of media planning concepts such as reach, frequency, frequency management, impression share, ROI, ROAS, and other KPIs.


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations


Certificates in Google DV360, Google Campaign Manager, and The Trade Desk required.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong analytical capabilities and an aptitude for understanding technical nuances associated with various media buying platforms to improve client results.
Proven experience developing ongoing processes that positively impact the profitability or efficiency of an account or team.
Establishes self as a trusted resource by developing relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
Superior oral and written communication skills, with a focus on fostering strong, collaborative relationships at a tactical level.

Gerente de Cuentas | Publicidad Digital

Forma parte de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. Con la videoteca más extensa de contenido propio y una capacidad de producción sin igual, impulsamos nuestras plataformas de televisión, streaming, radio y ecosistema digital, conectando diariamente con millones de personas a través de experiencias de entretenimiento y soluciones publicitarias innovadoras.

Somos una organización con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y Estados Unidos, comprometida con la innovación, la transformación digital y el desarrollo de nuestro talento.

Trabajarás en colaboración con equipos internos de ventas, marketing, producto, ingeniería y operaciones para garantizar una ejecución efectiva de campañas y una experiencia excepcional para clientes y agencias.

About the Role

Quectel is seeking an MBB Product Manager to support the 5G and mobile broadband product line in Mexico City. This position combines market intelligence, product planning, technical sales enablement, and business development. The successful candidate will partner with regional sales and product teams to identify module and ODM opportunities, shape competitive product offerings, and drive regional revenue and gross-profit growth.

Identify and develop new business opportunities for 5G/MBB modules and original design manufacturing (ODM) solutions, together with regional sales teams.

Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience and demonstrated capability.

Strong communication, customer-facing, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; detail-oriented approach and accountability for deliverables.

Prior experience with cellular module products, ODM programs, customer design-in/design-win cycles, and regional 5G business operations.
Experience supporting product launches, sales bidding, and technical-commercial discussions.
Working Portuguese, for collaboration with the Brazil team.




About Quectel

Quectel's passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate IoT innovation. A highly customer-centric organization, we are an end-to-end global IoT solutions provider backed by outstanding support and services. Our global team of more than 5,800 professionals leads the way in delivering cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, value-added services, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.




Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates regional offices, R&D centers, and technical support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, helping customers bring connected devices to market faster.




Industries & Applications

Quectel 5G and mobile broadband solutions power applications across:

Fixed Wireless Access & CPE — 5G routers, gateways, and home/enterprise broadband devices
Mobile Broadband Devices — Laptops, tablets, hotspots, and MiFi devices
Industrial IoT & Automation — Industrial routers, gateways, and private 5G networks
Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, V2X, and in-vehicle connectivity
Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Video surveillance, digital signage, and public safety
Enterprise & Retail — Payment terminals, kiosks, and enterprise connectivity




Why Quectel?

Global Impact, Regional Focus — Grow Quectel's 5G/MBB business in Mexico, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
Cutting-Edge Technology — Shape products in one of the most advanced 5G module and ODM portfolios in the industry.
Career Growth — International exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.
Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with product, sales, and technical experts worldwide.

Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
Annual performance bonus
Private health insurance, extendable to dependents
Life insurance
Paid time off plus statutory holidays, per local law
International exposure — industry events such as MWC and CES
Structured onboarding and ongoing product training

Explore products, careers, and news at www.quectel.com, or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.
